stumbles.quote: Tilting the top edge of the phone away from you accelerates, and tilting the top edge towards you brakes.
stumbles.why: The phone is held in landscape while racing, so I can't tell which edge is the "top". It could be the edge that was top in portrait, the edge on the right, or the edge on the left. The same doubt applies to what tilting "left and right" means in landscape.

point: Open the link on a phone with a motion sensor, with rotation locked to portrait. Pick the track, laps and difficulty, then turn the phone to landscape and hold it at your neutral angle until the lights go out. After that, tilt left and right to steer, and tilt forward or back to accelerate or brake.
